text.p: These are the leading stories in the Malawi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Opposition Alliance for Democracy on Tuesday re-affirmed its stand to continue boycotting parliament scheduled to open on December 9 in Zomba, southern Malawi.

- Police on Wednesday arrested 12 people and impounded two taxi buses nearly one kilometer from a polling centre in Machinga district, more than 100km north east of Blantyre, on suspicion that they were being ferried from outside the constituency to vote.
- Former President Kamuzu Banda said he would like his main opposition Malawi Congress Party to be strong in all parts of the country.
- Government planned to retrench more than 100,000 employees by January next year to create room for higher salary pay for those still serving, the Civil Servants Trade Union said.
